title: Every sprint review holds the held-out fitness rate at 86 of 99 with at most 8 false good, so token and time savings cannot hide a quality loss
goal: rag.py eval gains --max-false-good N (exit 1 when more than N failing rows are a false good: the verdict good where the row wants weak or none), and backlog.json review_checks runs python3 _tools/rag.py eval --file kb/public/_retrieval/lookup_heldout.csv --root public --min 86 --max-false-good 8 once per sprint review (about 8 s, not per landing). The thresholds only go up; the held-out file is refreshed by adding real query-log misses and never by moving failing rows out (maintaining.md). Extends EP-gzr4mmkm (fitness tests). Evidence: reliability-authority-review.md FT-1.
